title: Operator-Local Clearance Commit-Binding Policy Clarification
summary: Clarify the commit-binding policy for the operator-local clearance path after FP-MCP-224 exposed a mismatch between remote-runner request validation and the read-only operator-local clearance observer. The policy decision is to treat the authorization scope as a two-commit tuple: executionBaseCommit names the code/workspace state being authorized for model work, while requestArtifactCommit names the evidence commit proving the request artifact exists. Future observer validation should require the current workspace HEAD to equal requestArtifactCommit, require the request artifact execution base to match the approved executionBaseCommit, require executionBaseCommit to be an ancestor of requestArtifactCommit, and require the target workspace to be clean. This avoids invalidating a request merely because the request artifact itself was committed, while preserving exact current-HEAD binding for the evidence state that approval and local clearance observe.
caveats: This packet records policy clarification only; it does not modify MCP bridge code.
The current operator-local clearance observer may still require exact current commit to match targetExecutionCommit until a later implementation packet updates it.
No fresh approval should be recorded for FP-MCP-223 until the observer and approval terminology can represent the two-commit tuple or an equivalent safe binding.
The old FP-MCP-209 tuple remains stale and must not be used for local clearance.
FP-MCP-223 request REQ-20260703T125101090Z-8535b3c0 remains non-executing and only eligible under remote-runner request-artifact validation, not under the full operator-local clearance path.

policyDecision.executionBaseCommit: The repository state the model execution is being authorized to start from.
policyDecision.requestArtifactCommit: The committed evidence state proving the request artifact exists and is reachable from current HEAD.
observerShouldValidate: request artifact execution base equals approved executionBaseCommit
request id, approval id, model id, run mode, branch, and workspace id match the clearance scope
no broad or standing clearance flags are present
policyDecision.reason: Committing the request artifact is evidence creation and must not itself make the approved execution base stale, but the local clearance must still bind to an exact committed evidence state visible at current HEAD.

observedTrigger.remoteRunnerValidatorOutcome: eligible true for request artifact because creation commit is ancestor of artifact commit
observedTrigger.operatorLocalObserverConcern: exact current commit matching targetExecutionCommit would fail if targetExecutionCommit is interpreted only as execution base
